# Focus Sprint Planner

This directory contains Copilot-generated source text for an offline, dependency-free Focus Sprint Planner. A separate reviewer will save these values into the named files and test the result.

The application uses classic browser scripts and native controls, so `index.html` can be opened directly without a server. It stores sanitized task and sprint state in `localStorage`, handles unavailable or corrupt storage, and keeps user-provided strings out of HTML markup.

Tests are not yet run. The intended test command after the reviewer saves the files is:

```sh
node --test app.test.js
```

No GHW submission is claimed.
